subject: gk
question: Which ecosystem is the only one that does NOT thrive on solar energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deep sea hydro-thermal ecosystem.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deep-sea hydrothermal ecosystems exist at depths exceeding 1,000 meters on the ocean floor.**
 
• These ecosystems feature **hydrothermal vents, fissures in the Earth's crust, emitting hot, mineral-rich fluids **into the surrounding seawater.
 
• Vents are formed by **tectonic and volcanic processes**, releasing heated water containing high mineral concentrations.
 
• Life in these extreme environments includes bacteria, archaea, and specialized organisms **adapted to high pressure, darkness, and temperature fluctuations.**
 
• Unique microbial communities thrive around vents, utilizing **chemosynthesis **to produce organic matter from inorganic compounds.
 
• Hydrothermal vent ecosystems support diverse life forms such as **tube worms, clams, shrimp, and octopuses.**
 
• They contribute to global **biogeochemical **cycles and offer insights into the origins of life on Earth and potential extraterrestrial habitats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **ecosystem is the basic ecological unit **in which living organisms interact among themselves and with their surrounding physical environment.
 
• **Except for the deep sea hydro-thermal ecosystem**, the sun (sunlight) is the only source of energy for all ecosystems on earth.
 
• Out of the total incident solar radiation, **only 50% of it is photosynthetically active radiation (PAR).**
 
• **Plants capture only 2-10 per cent of the PAR **and this small amount of energy sustains the entire living world.
